svg.title: Body length
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Custom, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: body length at 73.5 mm. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes, the wing openings, the wall notch, the seat, the pocket and the body edge.
